chodong_note: 근사 표현 그대로: 'approximately 430,000 copies' — 근사치라 신뢰등급 B/C 경계.
chodong_source_quote: Within a week, approximately 430,000 copies of the EP were sold
notes: 한터차트 기준, Billboard Brasil 2025-09-24 경유 인용. 1일차 수치는 별도: 'Their EP sold approximately 250,000 copies on its first day, setting a new record for first-day sales by a K-pop act that debuted in 2025.' (Korea Herald, 김재헌, 2025-09-09) — 1일차는 초동 아님.
